question: Is the shared B-minus-C format direction at block 16 causally used by Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct when it writes the answer, or is it inert?
decoding: greedy, batch 1, same feed/decode call pattern as confirmation/run_batch.py

site.module: model.model.layers[15] output (block 16, before final norm); identical to v2.1 activation layer 16
site.positions: last prompt token at prefill and every generated token; in teacher-forced passes the last prompt token and every reference-answer input token

directions.built_by: intervention/directions.py, CPU only, before any new inference
directions.mean: cross-fitted: 5 folds over sources ordered by sha256(source_id + 'intervention-v1'); for a source in fold k use the mean ordinary (nat - flat) at layer 16 over the other four folds; the same vector serves both request types
directions.own: the source's own (nat - flat) at layer 16 for that request type
directions.wrong: own vector of the next source (cyclic, sorted source_id) with the same rule, same request type
directions.random: Gaussian direction, numpy seed 453 + source index, scaled to the norm of that source's mean vector

teacher_forced_kl.reference: greedy generated_ids of B (or C) from this run, including the stop token
teacher_forced_kl.measure: per position KL(p_ref_condition || p_condition) in float32 over the full vocabulary, averaged over reference positions; first-position KL and top-1 agreement also stored
teacher_forced_kl.note: p_ref_condition is itself recomputed teacher-forced, so the reference row is a numerical-floor check and should be ~0

primary.per_source: KL_B(C), KL_B(C_plus_mean), KL_B(C_plus_random), where KL_B(X) is mean KL along the B reference
primary.uncertainty: source bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 453, percentile 95% intervals

decision.direction_specific_effect: G lower bound > 0 and Delta lower bound > 0

secondary: same primary analysis for change requests, reported separately
G for C_minus_mean, C_plus_own, C_plus_wrong; G_B = 1 - KL_C(B_minus_mean) / KL_C(B)
exact generated-token agreement with B (C-family) or with C (B_minus_mean)
rule compliance with confirmation.common.check_rule, descriptive only
termination and length integrity: cap hits, unexpected role stops, mean words
reproduction of v2.1 B and C token streams on this GPU, descriptive

serializations.C_qa: same as C but role labels 'Q' and 'A'
serializations.C_json: history as a JSON list of {role, content} objects, then 'Current user request:' and the query

cross_format.capture: last prompt token, layers 4,8,12,16,20,24,28, conditions B, C, C_qa, C_json, no hook
cross_format.analysis: cosine of mean(B - variant) with the full-sample v2.1 ordinary mean direction per layer; paired sign of (B - variant) on that direction

preflight: all 240 B and 240 C prompt token IDs equal the v2.1 outputs.jsonl input_ids
zero-vector hook leaves prefill logits bitwise identical for one B and one C prompt
direction file SHA256 equals the registration
not_claimed: No claim about authorship, persona, general migration harm, other models or other tasks. Compliance changes are descriptive. A null result means this single-layer additive direction is not used at these positions, not that the format difference is behaviorally irrelevant in general.
